acs.text_first_line: Scenario: AC1 The scan operation is declared on the writeoff base with its shapes and its errors (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC2 The request, answer and write-off elements are fixed and no list of values is invented (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC3 The consumed rows of rwb-case and rwb-source-data are declared and the facts stay there (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC4 The rwb-decision row, the rights and the error envelope are fixed (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC5 The decision-record element is declared and the scan answer has no table (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC6 The seven fakes answer the document and the drift test fails a build (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC7 The naming baseline, the trigger and the boundary are fixed and no event is declared (new, D-RCV-60)

ops_consumed: GET the case list of the write-off stage, rwb-case (P3), /api/recovery/case/v1, operation name placeholder
The case-move answer to rwb-case (P3), the stage outcome on the child-workflow boundary, operation name placeholder
GET the ACE batch status of source ALS and the balance, rwb-source-data (P1), /api/recovery/source-data/v1, operation names placeholder
GET the WO rule package in force, rwb-decision (P7), /api/recovery/decision/v1, operation name placeholder
events_consumed: The ACE data-ready event of rwb-source-data for source ALS (monolith EV-26 AceDataReady), declared as the run's second trigger and not registered; the target event name follows the naming rule and is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-3017; ASM-5006)
workflows: WriteOffWorkflow on queue rwb-writeoff in namespace rwb-recovery, declared as the stage that hosts the scan
runMonthlyScan activity on queue rwb-writeoff, declared only
The JOB-16 Temporal Schedule on queue rwb-writeoff, declared as the trigger and not registered
